items.text: NOTICE: Hartwell Library will operate on a reduced schedule during spring break, March 10-14. Service is available at the Main Street desk only, 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM. Interlibrary loan requests made during this period incur a $2 processing charge. Regular hours resume March 17.

questions.stem: According to the notice, what is true about library service during spring break?

options.A: The library keeps one desk open during the break.
options.B: The library shuts for the entire spring break.
options.C: The library waives fees for loan requests.
options.D: The library opens at 4:00 PM on weekdays.

questions.explanation: The notice states that service during March 10-14 is available at the Main Street desk only, meaning just one service point remains open.

questions.stem: The word 'resume' in the notice is closest in meaning to
questions.explanation: In context, 'Regular hours resume March 17' means the normal schedule starts up again after the break.

items.text: Hi Dana, Your replacement student ID is ready at the Card Office, Room 12, Student Union. Pay the $10 fee by card or cash and bring photo ID. Unclaimed cards are destroyed after 30 days, so please come before May 9. — Campus Card Services

questions.stem: What must Dana do to obtain the new student ID?

options.B: To mail the fee to Campus Card Services
options.C: To wait thirty days before collecting it
options.D: To bring identification and pay ten dollars

questions.explanation: The email instructs Dana to pay the $10 fee and bring photo ID when collecting the card at Room 12.

questions.stem: What can be inferred about Dana's student ID?

options.C: Dana must collect it in person.
options.D: Dana can get it at another office.

questions.explanation: Because Dana is told to bring photo ID and pay at the Card Office, the card evidently has to be picked up in person rather than sent.

items.text: NOTICE: The bike racks outside Kellner Hall will be removed on Tuesday, April 8, while the sidewalk is repaired. Cyclists should use the racks near the North Garage. Bikes left behind after Monday evening will be moved there by Facilities staff. Work runs 7:00 AM to 3:00 PM.

questions.stem: According to the notice, what will happen to bicycles left at the Kellner Hall racks?

options.A: They will be fixed by Facilities staff.
options.B: They will be locked inside Kellner Hall.
options.C: They will be given to their owners.
options.D: They will be relocated to another area.

questions.explanation: The notice says bikes left after Monday evening will be moved by Facilities staff to the racks near the North Garage.

questions.stem: Where are cyclists advised to park during the repair work?

options.B: The racks by the North Garage.
options.D: The racks at the south entrance.

questions.explanation: The notice directs cyclists to use the racks near the North Garage while the Kellner Hall racks are gone.

items.text: Hi Omar, This confirms your tutoring session with Ms. Cole on Thursday, March 6, at 3:30 PM in Room 118, Baker Library. Please arrive ten minutes early. A $5 no-show charge applies to missed appointments; it is billed to your student account. — Tutoring Center

questions.stem: Where will Omar's tutoring session be held?

options.D: In a classroom in Baker Hall

questions.explanation: The email specifies the meeting place as Room 118 in Baker Library.

questions.stem: What happens if Omar does not show up for the appointment?

options.A: He will be charged five dollars.
options.B: He will lose his tutoring slot.
options.C: He will be asked to pay in cash.
options.D: He will be sent a reminder.

questions.explanation: The email states that a $5 no-show charge applies to missed appointments and is billed to the student account.
